 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE KHATIM REZA  ORAL ORDER 2 04-12-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 364C/2022 instituted for the offence punishable under Sections 498(A) of the Indian Penal Code and under Section  of the D.P. Act.
3.
The prosecution case, in short, is that the marriage of the opposite party no. 2 (Rambha Devi) was solemnized with the petitioner (Bauaalal Pandit).
After one month of marriage, the accused persons including the petitioner started torturing the complainant (O.P. No. 2) on the pretext of dowry and forced her to leave her matrimonial house.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.80958 of 2024(2) dt.04-12-2024 4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is further submitted that petitioner is the husband of the opposite party no. 2.

It is next submitted that prior to the present case opposite party no. 2 had filed Birpur P.S.

sentences.text: Case No. 38 of 2021 dated 01.02.2021 under Sections 341, 323, 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the D.P. Act against the petitioner and his family members.

Learned counsel further submitted that at that time, the petitioner was declared juvenile and since the petitioner was in custody, he was granted bail vide order dated 18.08.2021 passed in G.R. 80/2021, Birpur 38/21,
ER-79/2021.

It is further submitted that petitioner has filed Matrimonial Case No. 16/2021 in the Court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Supaul for declaration of his marriage with the opposite party no. 2 as null and void, which is pending for its final adjudication.

entities.text: Court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Supaul
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is next submitted that the said matrimonial case has been filed on 15.02.2021 while the present case has been lodged on 27.09.2022.
It is further submitted that complainant has not whispered about the earlier case as well as her date of marriage with the petitioner.
Learned counsel further submitted that the date of marriage has been disclosed by the opposite party no. 2 in her solemn affirmation as 02.10.2020 but Patna High Court CR.
the actual date of marriage is 15.12.2020 and at that time, petitioner was minor and only 17 years old.
Lastly, it has been submitted that petitioner has one criminal case against him.
5. Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner.

6. Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case and submissions of learned counsel for the parties, in the event of arrest / surrender of the petitioner within a period of six weeks from today, in connection with Complaint Case No. 364C/2022, he/they shall be released on anticipatory bail upon furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned S.D.J.M., Birpur, Supaul, subject to condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Khatim Reza, J) Sankalp/-
